summary.text: Keep source availability, bounded document discovery, pending Claim candidates, and ValidatedEvidence distinct while recovering deterministic document dates and context.

mechanism.text: Parse bounded HTML metadata and JSON-LD with explicit date precedence, retain DocumentKind through SourceObservation and EvidenceCandidate provenance, count classified documents in optional ResearchMetrics, and render sorted localized counters without feeding judgment or Ranking.

affectedComponents.detail: Recovers publication/effective dates and classifies same-origin discovered documents without changing the bounded crawl.
Propagates DocumentKind only for discovered documents and retains it in normalized claim provenance; generic, incomplete, and page-level material remains unconfirmed.
Adds optional document-kind counts with legacy empty-map defaults and localized sorted display.
Counts document kinds at the existing observation loop while leaving SEC, judgment, Stage, Ranking, delivery, archive, and workflow paths unchanged.

designDecisions.decision: Prefer false negatives to page-level or generic prose promotion.
designDecisions.reason: A reachable homepage or technical description does not establish an enterprise production-system change.

evidence.subject: homepage, generic, title-only, and non-actionable negative fixtures

designDecisions.decision: Use deterministic metadata precedence and existing cutoff validation.
designDecisions.reason: The parser can recover explicit dates already present in publisher markup without guessing ambiguous values or weakening the future-date gate.

evidence.subject: metadata precedence and ISO date-prefix parsing

designDecisions.decision: Keep document-kind counts observational and out of judgment.
designDecisions.reason: Research Value improves through visibility into ingestion quality; Stage and Ranking must continue to consume only their existing evidence inputs.

technicalDetails.detail: Checks article:published_time, meta name=date, JSON-LD datePublished, time datetime, then JSON-LD dateModified; malformed values are skipped and the existing validation cutoff rejects future evidence.
A classified, dated official document must provide a bounded body sentence with change and production signals, source title, URI, passage, and authoritative provenance before promotion.
Document-kind metrics are optional in serialized ResearchMetrics and default to an empty map for legacy runtime inputs.
TDD fixtures cover positive and negative extraction, localized reporting, and full repository regression; governance evidence is recorded by ai-finish.
